query:
UPDATE meet_profiles
         SET lat        = COALESCE($2, lat),
             lon        = COALESCE($3, lon),
             headline   = COALESCE($4, headline),
             char_config = COALESCE($5, char_config),
             active     = COALESCE($6, active),
             updated_at = now()
         WHERE user_id = $1
